name: qwen38_flash_next_flavors
description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (qwen4exp) containers on Strix Halo that gufo core rejects: pruned 256-expert coder builds and 512-expert requantizations, IQ1_M through Q5_1, with the per-layer n-gram table served from disk

releases.notes: Built on Gufo's qwen38_flash_next runtime as a dependency (gufo-org/gufo#1376): custom WeightSource binds the flavor checkpoint, the Q5_1/IQ4_NL n-gram table streams through NgramTable::OpenEncoded, the per-layer token embedding reads with pread, and the MoE FFN plus the format_state linear stages are overridden. Decode and draft-verify passes compact their routed buckets in-module (the host leaves expert_counts to the vector route), which is what keeps the 512-expert AtomicChat artifact coherent at batch 1; MTP verify and component-cache catch-up reach the experts as bare Linear/LinearGroup calls, so those read the flavor experts through the same WMMA route instead of the default stages' format rejection. Catch-up passes (routing.last_only) run over the last row alone. Needs Gufo 831c55d3 or later; Linux only.

First registry release, as qwen38_flash_next_flavors. Installs as a module against a released gufo 0.3.37, no core patch. Serves the ISTA GSQ-RCO Coder IQ1_M (256 experts, IQ4_NL n-gram table), AtomicChat AD-4.27bpw-Q4_K_M-M64 (512 experts, three shards, Q5_1 table) and the Swift 1.5 GSQ-RCO IQ3_S re-quantization. Measured on gfx1151 with 128 GiB unified memory.
